headline: 12 Michigan deals, $95.7M raised — led by Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P.

top_deals.company: Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P.
top_deals.summary: Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P., a Grand Rapids-based investment fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $65.4M sold to 82 investors. (Amended filing.)
Gold Plus Coin LLC, an Okemos-based financial services company, filed a $20M equity offering under Rule 506(c); $0 sold to 1 investor.
Enumera Molecular, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based health care company, filed a $17.4M equity and other securities offering under Rule 506(b); $12.3M sold to 12 investors.

Genomenon, Inc., an Ann Arbor-based biotechnology company, filed a $10M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $6M sold to 30 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $95.7M sold across 12 Form D filings this week, up 212% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Gold Plus Coin LLC (Okemos, Other Banking and Financial Services) targeting $20M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $65.5M raised so far — led by Michigan Capital Network Venture Fund V, L.P. (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Real Estate was the most active sector with 3 of 12 filings (25%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
